annotations.title: Report a mission stuck or refused

description: Reports a mission you couldn't send, and why: a login you don't have, a page that changed, a button that isn't there. If the platform showed a warning, a captcha, a rate limit or a restriction, say which in saw and send nothing more on that platform this wake. If the platform won't take the text as it is (too long, a blocked link), report it here: never shorten or change it. With refused true: you won't send it. Marsell never rewords a refused mission to get past the refusal: it goes on the owner's own list to send themselves, and two refusals of the same kind on one platform within a week stop Marsell giving you those.

mission_id.description: The mission's id from missions_next (ms- and 16 hex characters).

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

refused.description: true: you won't send this mission.

saw.description: What the platform showed, if anything: banner (a warning), captcha, rate_limit or restricted.

session.description: A short name for this session of yours (letters, digits, dots, dashes, colons or underscores, up to 64), made up once when this wake starts and passed the same to missions_next and every report. A mission is held for the session that took it: another session gets a different one, or hears when to come back, and only the session that took a mission reports it.

why.description: Why it couldn't be sent, or why you won't send it, in plain words.
